chunks.arabic_text: عَلِيُّ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجْرَانَ، عَنْ عَاصِمِ بْنِ حَمِيدٍ، عَنْ مَنْصُورِ بْنِ حَازِمٍ قَالَ

translations.en: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Najran, from Asim ibn Humayd, from Mansur ibn Hazim who said:

chunks.arabic_text: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ: مَا بَالِي أَسْأَلُكَ عَنِ الْمَسْأَلَةِ فَتُجِيبُنِي فِيهَا بِالْجَوَابِ، ثُمَّ يَجِيئُكَ غَيْرِي فَتُجِيبُهُ فِيهَا بِجَوَابٍ آخَرَ؟ فَقَالَ: إِنَّا نُجِيبُ النَّاسَ عَلَى الزِّيَادَةِ وَالنَّقْصَانِ. قُلْتُ: فَأَخْبِرْنِي عَنْ أَصْحَابِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ، صَدَقُوا عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ أَمْ كَذَبُوا؟ قَالَ: بَلْ صَدَقُوا. قُلْتُ: فَمَا بَالُهُمْ اخْتَلَفُوا؟ فَقَالَ: أَمَا تَعْلَمُ أَنَّ الرَّجُلَ كَانَ يَأْتِي رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ فَيَسْأَلُهُ عَنِ الْمَسْأَلَةِ فَيُجِيبُهُ فِيهَا بِالْجَوَابِ، ثُمَّ يُجِيبُهُ بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ بِمَا يَنْسَخُ ذَلِكَ الْجَوَابَ، فَانْسَخَتِ الْأَحَادِيثُ بَعْضُهَا بَعْضًا

translations.en: I said to Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him): Why is it that I ask you about an issue and you answer me with a certain answer, then someone else comes to you and you answer him with a different answer? He said: We answer the people with addition and with deletion. I said: So inform me about the companions of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) — were they truthful about Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family) or did they lie? He said: They were truthful. I said: So what was the matter with them that they differed? He said: Do you not know that a man used to come to the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) and ask him about an issue, so he answers him with an answer, then he answers him after that with that which abrogates that answer, so the narrations superseded one another.

en.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) explains that variations in his answers to different people arise from 'addition' (detail) and 'deletion' (briefness). He further clarifies that the differences among the Companions of the Prophet were not due to dishonesty, but because the Prophet's own answers were subject to abrogation (naskh), where later answers superseded earlier ones, leading to diverse narrations.
en.seo_question: Why did the Companions of the Prophet differ in their narrations if they were truthful?

key_terms.الزِّيَادَةُ وَالنَّقْصَانُ: Addition and deletion (in-depth and brief answers)
